daily-prayer.what-arrives-each-mornin.a-: A prayer to open the day
A short morning prayer you can pray in a quiet minute, or carry with you through the day.
daily-prayer.what-arrives-each-mornin.th: The mystery set for the day, listed one by one - ready to pray or to meditate at your own pace.
daily-prayer.what-arrives-each-mornin.a-: A daily prayer asking his intercession, with a link to all the Maronite prayers of the day.
daily-prayer.from-the-daily-email.o-god-: O God, infinitely holy and glorified in Your saints, You inspired Saint Charbel to live and die in perfect union with Christ. Through his intercession, grant me the grace I seek in faith and trust: [name your intention]. Help me to walk in conversion, humility, and perseverance, and to surrender completely to Your will. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
daily-prayer.receive-the-daily-prayer.no: No account, no password. Your email is used only for the daily prayer, and every email carries a one-tap unsubscribe.
daily-prayer.receive-the-daily-prayer.we: We send one confirmation email first. Your subscription begins only after you tap the link inside it.
daily-prayer.human-verification.complete: Complete the security check, then subscribe.
